subject: Performance Review Notes - Confidential
body:
Hi Sarah,

Ahead of your annual review, here are my preliminary notes:

Strengths:
- Excellent stakeholder management
- Strong product launches in Q3/Q4
- Team gives positive feedback on your leadership

Growth areas:
- Could delegate more to grow team members
- Consider more strategic vs tactical focus

Let's discuss next week. This is between us for now.

David
